# Robert James - Portfolio & UX Engineering Lab

> Robert James is a UX Engineer who designs and builds digital experiences and products. This repository contains his personal website, resume, design system pattern library, and a collection of interactive experimental lab projects.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://robertjames.nyc/): Personal details, brand interactions, and highlights.
- [Resume](https://robertjames.nyc/resume.html): Detailed professional background, education, and technical skill set.
- [UX Engineering Lab](https://robertjames.nyc/lab.html): The hub for various web experiments, interactive simulations, and animation prototypes.
- [Pattern Library](https://robertjames.nyc/pattern-library.html): Shared component and typography library showcasing CSS design tokens.

## Interactive Lab Projects

- [Interactive Headphones](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/headphones.html): Interactive headphones animation featuring configurable 3D-like states, ambient audio preview playback, and fade out capabilities.
- [Framer Flows](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/framer-flows.html): Simulation demonstrating smooth workflow animations and transitions mimicking Framer interfaces.
- [Emoji Speaker](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/emoji-speaker.html): Interactive layout showcasing custom grid animations with animated emoji audio visualizations.
- [Google Search Loader](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/google-search-loader.html): Reconstruction of Google Search loading/processing visual indicators.
- [Google Loader](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/google-loader.html): CSS-only replication of Google's standard animated loading dot loops.
- [Framer Loaders](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/framer-loaders.html): Re-creation of loaders and spinners matching Framer design aesthetics.
- [Microsoft Logo](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/microsoft-logo.html): Animated CSS transition recreation of Microsoft's branding grid.
- [Framer Logo](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/framer-logo.html): Re-creation of Framer's signature geometric branding animation.
- [Figma Logo](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/figma-logo.html): Smooth CSS translation of Figma's classic branding shapes.
- [Buttons Custom Properties](https://robertjames.nyc/lab/buttons-custom-properties.html): Micro-interaction demos of CSS Custom Property-driven button animations.
